risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Ongoing armed conflicts and geopolitical developments pose risks to global trade, energy prices and supply chains, potentially disrupting shipping routes, raising freight/insurance costs, and delaying exports and customer deliveries.
- The company's principal risks include volatility in raw-material and energy costs, which affects margins and cost of production.
- Aggressive pricing and dumping by overseas manufacturers, especially from China, continues to pressure the company's selling prices and margins.
- Currency volatility may impact international business and margins, especially given the company's export exposure.
- Tariffs imposed by the United States and shifting global trade conditions affected delivery schedules, margins and cash flows during the year, causing lower export offtake in key markets.
- The company's principal risks include availability of key raw-material inputs.
- Regulatory requirements and execution risks are associated with the company's operational initiatives.
- Company's turnover remains focused on the export market even as exports declined sharply (about 84.72% year-on-year decline in export revenue), with exports still constituting roughly 12.03% of overall revenue including other income.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)

- Expanding applications of legacy products (e.g. m-Aminophenol) in advanced materials sciences through customer collaboration.
- Pursuing zero effluent discharge across operations, including legacy products, supported by investment in renewable energy (solar power and green hydrogen).
